<style id="vi-dtn-selector-style-inline-css">
.create-interactive-map-widget {
    height: 600px;
}

.create-local-weather-map-widget button {
    padding: 0px !important;
    color: #000 !important;
    background: white !important;
}

#cash-bids-table-widget-6 table tr td:nth-child(3) {
    color: #0060BF;
}

.dtn-widget {
    background-color: #fff;
}

.dtn-widget.padded {
    padding: 20px;
}

.dtn-widget.padded table thead th {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px;
}

.dtn-widget.padded table tbody {
    font-size: 16px;
}

.dtn-widget.padded table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
    background-color: #f1f1f1;
}

.dtn-widget.padded table tbody td button {
    background-color: transparent;
    padding: 0 10px;
}

#create-dtn-news-widget ol li {
    list-style-type: none;
}

.dtn-widget.padded.options-table-widget > div > div > div:nth-child(2) > div  {
    align-items: flex-start;
}

.futures-wrapper {
    position: relative
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-table.chart-showing:before {
    content: "";
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-chart {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 9;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-chart.hide {
    display: none;
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-chart button {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 0 10px 0;
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-option {
    /* position: fixed;
    z-index: 9;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%); */
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-option.hide {
    display: none;
}

.futures-wrapper .futures-option button {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 0 10px 0;
}


.cashbids-wrapper {
    position: relative
}

.cashbids-wrapper .cash-bids-table.chart-showing:before {
    content: "";
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2;
}

.cashbids-wrapper .cash-bids-chart {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 9;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

.cashbids-wrapper .cash-bids-chart.hide {
    display: none;
}

.cashbids-wrapper .cash-bids-chart button {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 0 10px 0;
}

/* 
#cash-bids-table-combined tbody tr:nth-child(8) {
    border-bottom: solid 3px #000 !important;
} */

.cash-bids-table tbody tr td:nth-child(3) {
    background-color: yellow;
}

#create-local-weather-map-widget {
    position: relative;
}

#create-local-weather-map-widget {
    position: relative;
}

#create-local-weather-map-widget .weather-search-btn {
    position: absolute;
    top: 32px;
    right: 30px;
    z-index: 9;
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 960px) {
}

		<script>
			// Simple get cookie function
			function getCookie(cname) {
				let name = cname + "=";
				let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
				let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
				for(let i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
					let c = ca[i];
					while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
						c = c.substring(1);
					}
					if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
						return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
					}
				}
				return "";
			}

			// Look for a DTN Cash Bid location cookie and alter the location to load if one exists otherwise default to Goodhue
			const user_selected_location = getCookie( 'DTNCashBid' );
			if ( !user_selected_location ) {
				var cash_bid_location = "Goodhue";
			} else {
				var cash_bid_location = user_selected_location;
			}

			let cash_bids_combinedChart;

			var cash_bid_combined_args = {
				"apiKey": "<redacted>",
				"container": "#cash-bids-combined-table",
				"siteId": "e0172401",
				"groupBy": "LOCATION",
				"showGroupByOptions": true,
				"view": "DETAIL",
				"showViewOptions": true,
				"showLocationsSelect": true,
				"showCommoditiesSelect": true,
				"defaultLocation": {
					"locationName": cash_bid_location
				},
				"hideCommodities": [
					"Canola",
				],
				"hideLocations": [
					"Canada"
				],
				"deliveryDateFormat": "DELIVERY_LABEL",
				"visibleFields": [
					"FUTURES_CHANGE",
					"CASH_PRICE",
					"DELIVERY_END",
					"BASIS_PRICE",
					"SYMBOL",
					"FUTURES_QUOTE"
				],
				"callbacks": {
					async onCashBidSelect(portalCashBid) {
						console.log(portalCashBid);
						if (cash_bids_combinedChart) {
							cash_bids_combinedChart.setCashBid(portalCashBid);
						} else {
							cash_bids_combinedChart = await createCashBidsCombinedChartWidget(portalCashBid);
						}
						console.log(cash_bids_combinedChart);
						let chart_container = document.getElementById("cash-bids-combined-chart-widget");
						chart_container.classList.remove('hide');
						let table_container = document.getElementById("cash-bids-combined-table");
						table_container.classList.add('chart-showing');
					},
				},
			}

			const cash_bids_combined_chart_button = document.getElementById("btn-close-cashbids-chart");
			cash_bids_combined_chart_button.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
				// Code to execute when the button is clicked
				const parent = event.target.parentElement;
				parent.classList.add('hide');
				let table_container = document.getElementById("cash-bids-combined-table");
				table_container.classList.remove('chart-showing');
			});
			// Initial load of the widget
			window.dtn.cashBids.createCashBidsTableWidget(cash_bid_combined_args);
			// Reload the Cash Bids script automatically every 2 mins
			setInterval( async () => { 
				window.dtn.cashBids.createCashBidsTableWidget(cash_bid_combined_args);
			}, 120000);

			// When a user changes the Cash Bid location store that selection in a cookie for future use.
			jQuery(document).ready(function ( $ ) {
				$('.vi-custom-dtn-selector-block').on('change', '#cash-bids-combined-table select', function() {
					const selected_location = $(this).find(":selected").val();
					document.cookie = 'DTNCashBid='+selected_location+'';
					cash_bid_location = selected_location;
					cash_bid_combined_args = {
						"apiKey": "<redacted>",
						"container": "#cash-bids-combined-table",
						"siteId": "e0172401",
						"groupBy": "LOCATION",
						"showGroupByOptions": true,
						"view": "DETAIL",
						"showViewOptions": true,
						"showLocationsSelect": true,
						"showCommoditiesSelect": true,
						"defaultLocation": {
							"locationName": selected_location
						},
						"hideCommodities": [
							"Canola"
						],
						"hideLocations": [
							"Canada"
						],
						"deliveryDateFormat": "DELIVERY_LABEL",
						"visibleFields": [
							"FUTURES_CHANGE",
							"CASH_PRICE",
							"DELIVERY_END",
							"BASIS_PRICE",
							"SYMBOL",
							"FUTURES_QUOTE"
						],
						"callbacks": {
							async onCashBidSelect(portalCashBid) {
								console.log(portalCashBid);
								if (cash_bids_combinedChart) {
									cash_bids_combinedChart.setCashBid(portalCashBid);
								} else {
									cash_bids_combinedChart = await createCashBidsCombinedChartWidget(portalCashBid);
								}
								console.log(cash_bids_combinedChart);
								let chart_container = document.getElementById("cash-bids-combined-chart-widget");
								chart_container.classList.remove('hide');
								let table_container = document.getElementById("cash-bids-combined-table");
								table_container.classList.add('chart-showing');
							},
						},
					}
				});
			});

			async function createCashBidsCombinedChartWidget(portalCashBid) {
				let chart = await window.window.dtn.cashBids.createCashBidsChartWidget({
					"apiKey": "<redacted>",
					"container": "#cash-bids-combined-chart-widget-inner",
					...portalCashBid,
